title: Chapter 118
text:
You are now slightly poisoned. You will lose 3 HP per second for 60 seconds.

As long as they didn't leave the range of the poisonous gas, the poisoned status would remain. Furthermore, the degree of the poisoned status would only worsen. If the Hidden Demon continued to attack, he would have to suffer the damage from the poisonous gas as well.

Han Xiao was not afraid at all. He had [Beginner Strengthened Life], and his HP was over 2,000. He was not afraid of running out of HP at all. He was bold and decisive. He used an unorthodox method to drag the battlefield into an advantageous situation, breaking the enemy's invisible advantage!

The situation was at a stalemate. The Hidden Demon couldn't do anything to him, and he couldn't hit the Hidden Demon either.

"Although I'm in an invincible position, I can't do anything to him. If this continues, the Hidden Demon will definitely retreat, and the final result will still be a draw."

Han Xiao was determined to kill the enemy who threatened his life. After thinking about it carefully, he decided to give up on the advantageous situation that he had created. He activated his Hover-boots and ran away. As expected, the Hidden Demon chased after him.

Han Xiao pretended to be a little slower in controlling the armor so that the Hidden Demon could see the flaw and clawed at his back. The five deep claw marks on his flesh were burning with pain, but his expression did not change. This was to test the Hidden Demon's attack on his body.

[You have been attacked by the Hidden Demon (LV44). You have lost 37 HP.]

"A single attack can deal around 40 damage, and the attack frequency is very high. If I didn't have the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor, my health bar would be empty in ten seconds!"

Han Xiaoxin's expression was solemn. He guessed that the Hidden Demon was a strong enemy in the fifth round of the mission. Perhaps the first target was not him, but another assassin had already been killed.

By constantly adjusting the speed of his skateboard shoes, he estimated the speed of the Hidden Demon's pursuit.

'If I maintain the power output of my skateboard shoes at a medium speed, it'll be a speed where the Hidden Demon can easily catch up to me, but it won't be easy for him. I can give it a try!'

A new plan formed in his mind. Han Xiao immediately turned around and slid towards the airport. The Hidden Demon continued to chase after him.

Luckily, it was dawn, and the streets were deserted. It was not time for work yet, or else Han Xiao would have been stuck in traffic.

He took out his phone and quickly dialed Antonio's number, asking him to send the Second Generation Rangers over. He then hung up the phone and focused on "fishing."

Being a bait was a skill. If he made it too obvious that he had a trump card, the enemy wouldn't fall for it. It was like playing a MOBA game. If you suddenly moved forward during a matchup, others would know that you were trying to drain their health or that there was a jungler behind you.

The chase lasted for a few minutes. Suddenly, the sense of danger that was pressing down on Han Xiaoxin disappeared. He immediately stopped skateboarding and looked around vigilantly. Only then did he confirm that the Hidden Demon had escaped and did not step into his trap.

The Hidden Demon was very vigilant. When Han Xiao released the poison gas, he was already prepared to retreat. However, Han Xiao gave up on the advantageous environment, causing the Hidden Demon to think that Han Xiao couldn't withstand the poison gas. Thus, he chased after him.

However, the Hidden Demon soon felt that something was amiss. Although Han Xiao did not reveal any flaws, his instincts told him that he was in danger. Thus, he decisively retreated and gave up on the assassination.

"He's too vigilant." Han Xiao was slightly disappointed. However, he quickly got rid of this feeling. If the Hidden Demon was so easy to deal with, he wouldn't be listed as the most difficult player to kill.

You said that the Black Spider was easy to deal with? Yes, although he was captured and brought to Bell of Death Island, he was not dead yet.

This short and dangerous battle revealed some problems. When facing an enemy above LV 40, regardless of whether the enemy was an agility attacker or a tank, the power of the gun was not enough. The main reason was that he could not hit the enemy often, and he did not have any powerful control skills.

The problem that Han Xiao was thinking about was the awkwardness of the Mechanic class in Version 1.0. Normal light gunpowder weapons had limited lethality when facing Supers of level fifty to sixty. Although the various bombs, missiles, and multi-barreled cannons were powerful enough, it was not easy to hit Supers of this level unless traps were set up beforehand.

The electromagnetic Gaussian gun was the next generation of weapon technology. Be it the speed of fire or the power, it had improved tremendously. It was perfect for Han Xiao's needs. Furthermore, the bullet speed of electromagnetic weapons was higher, which made it more difficult for the enemy to dodge.

However, a proper, perfect, and stable electromagnetic weapon could only be created after one had learned the Advanced Electromagnetic Theory. The Advanced Electromagnetic Theory on Blue Star was strictly controlled.

If I want to create an electromagnetic gun now, I can only try to create my own blueprint. The theory behind the portable electromagnetic gun is not very deep, and I can grasp it myself when Basic Electromagnetic Theory is at Level 5. However, to turn it into an actual object, it will require a lot of adjustments, and it will be very difficult. If I want to reduce the research time, it will be best if I can use it as a reference. For example, I can come up with many other electromagnetic blueprints and compare them …

Han Xiao frowned and pondered.

Not long after, Antonio arrived with the truck. He looked around and asked, "Where is the enemy you were talking about?"

"He ran away."

Han Xiao jumped into the truck and said, "Let's go to the plane first. I need to repair my equipment and try out a new idea."

"Are you using me as a driver?"

Antonio had no choice but to drive Han Xiao to the airport.

…

The battle between Han Xiao and the Hidden Demon was not small. Division 13 found traces of him and quickly reported it.

"A sniper who was not afraid of the Hidden Demon's assassination and even forced the Hidden Demon to retreat?"

Di Su Su was shocked. When she first entered River Valley Manor, it was this Mr. Black who made her feel threatened. He was indeed extraordinary.

Bennett's eyes lit up. He was a little surprised.

"Where is he now?"

"He has some connections with the Farian Group. He is on the Farian Group's transport plane at the airport."

"He should be repairing his equipment," Wang Yuan said. "Don't summon him yet. Mo Ran, please ask your people to help me send a message. Ask Mr. Black to return to River Valley Manor before tomorrow morning."

"Okay." Mo Ran nodded.

The Golden Fox, who had been summoned, was on the side. She was scared. Mr. Black was the fourth target, and she was the fifth. Fortunately, Mr. Black had forced the Hidden Demon to retreat and saved her life.

The Golden Fox did not think that she could survive the Hidden Demon's assassination.

"He saved my life indirectly."

The Golden Fox bit her lips. Mr. Black was mysterious and powerful. He was good at everything, but his taste was too strong.

…

In the workshop of the military transport plane, Han Xiao repaired the magnetically-controlled armor with ease. Then, he started to think about the creation of electromagnetic guns. The best model would be a sniper rifle. With his sniping ability, he could maximize the power.

He had seven potential points. Han Xiao spent five points to increase [Basic Electromagnetism], [Basic Weapon Theory], and [Basic Energy Theory] to the maximum level of Level 5.

Then, Han Xiao used [Basic Electromagnetism] as the core to form various knowledge combinations. He came up with various blueprints related to electromagnetism. He did not expect to create useful blueprints. Instead, he wanted to create practical applications for the blueprints. He tried each knowledge combination twice at most. He used less experience to obtain more blueprints.

After obtaining a large number of blueprints related to electromagnetism, Han Xiao felt a little dizzy. He rubbed his temples to relieve his mental fatigue. He thought to himself, This should be enough. I can try creating my own blueprints.

The Fabian Company did not have a supply channel in Seagull City. Han Xiao had brought along electromagnetic components. Although there were not many of them, he could dismantle them and reuse them. Of course, there would be some one-use parts that would be damaged every time. The recycling rate was about 80%.

Han Xiao predicted that it would be difficult to create a stable electromagnetic gun without dozens of failed attempts as a foundation.

If I want to achieve a high success rate, I can only lower my standards and create an incomplete electromagnetic gun. The power and various parameters will have to be adjusted …
